The section file sections/contact-languages.liquid renders a contact block. It reads `section.settings.heading` (string or null) and `section.settings.email` (string or null). It currently outputs `
`, then `

` with the escaped heading when the heading is non-null and non-empty, then `

` with the escaped email when the email is non-null and non-empty, then `

`. There is no whitespace between tags. Change: support a new top-level variable `languages` (an array of strings, never null, possibly empty). When it has at least one entry, output `

Languages: X

` immediately after the email paragraph position (i.e. as the last child of the div, after heading and email when present). X is the entries in their given order, each HTML-escaped, joined with a comma followed by a single space (`, `), with no separator before the first or after the last entry. Example: ["English","French"] gives `Languages: English, French`. When `languages` is empty, output nothing for it (no paragraph). Do not add whitespace between tags. Keep all existing behavior, markup and the {% schema %} block byte-for-byte unchanged. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/contact-languages.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
